name: Hazael
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Elisha tells Hazael the king may recover but the Most High has shown that he shall surely die, then weeps because he sees the evil Hazael will do to Israel: burning strongholds, slaying young men, and ripping up women with child.

note.label: 2 Kings 8: The Prophet Weeps Over Israel's Coming Affliction

points: Elisha tells Hazael he will be king over Syria, revealing that leadership can discern spirits at work in a man that the man does not see in himself. Hazael returns and smothers the king with a wet cloth and reigns in his place.

note.label: 2 Kings 8: The Prophet Weeps Over Israel's Coming Affliction

points: He goes with Jehoram son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria, and the Syrians wound Jehoram at Ramah.

note.label: 2 Kings 8: The Prophet Weeps Over Israel's Coming Affliction

points: In those days the Most High begins to cut Israel short, and Hazael smites them in all the coasts from Jordan eastward through Gilead and Bashan.

note.label: 2 Kings 10: Jehu Destroys Baal and Falls Short of the Law

points: Hazael king of Syria took Gath and set his face to go up against Jerusalem.

note.label: 2 Kings 12: Repairing the House and Dealing Faithfully

points: Jehoash took the hallowed things dedicated by the former kings, and the gold from the treasures, and sent them to Hazael, who then went away.

note.label: 2 Kings 12: Repairing the House and Dealing Faithfully

points: The anger of the Most High was kindled and He delivered Israel into the hand of Hazael and Ben-hadad of Syria all their days.

note.label: 2 Kings 13: The Death of Elisha and the Arrows of Deliverance

points: After Hazael died, Jehoash beat Ben-hadad his son three times and recovered the cities of Israel, according to the word Elisha spoke.

note.label: 2 Kings 13: The Death of Elisha and the Arrows of Deliverance

points: Ahaziah walked after their counsel and went with Jehoram son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth-gilead, where Jehoram was wounded.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 22: Ahaziah and the Rise of Athaliah
